event: KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America 2026 · Salt Lake City
disclaimer: Traced from the official KCNA26 venue map and Solutions Showcase map: rooms, halls and booths sit where those PDFs draw them, simplified to blocks. Each building view keeps its own scale.
